listing.name: Endless Sky
listing.summary: Captain a ship, trade cargo, and explore a galaxy of stories in an open-source space adventure.
listing.download_block_reason: Choose the package for your system from the publisher or use your package manager.

steps.title: Choose a desktop package
steps.instruction: On Windows, extract the whole ZIP for your system and open Endless Sky.exe. On Linux x86-64, allow the publisher AppImage to run as a program and open it, or use your distribution’s package. Flathub also offers Linux x86-64 and ARM64. On Mac, open the publisher disk image and copy Endless Sky.app to Applications.

steps.title: Start a pilot
steps.instruction: Choose New Pilot, then select a starting scenario. The game saves progress while you are landed.

warnings: Before updating or moving the game, close it and copy the whole player-data folder, including saves, pilots, preferences, and plugins.

references.title: Find your player data
references.instruction: The default folder is %APPDATA%/endless-sky on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/endless-sky on Mac, and ~/.local/share/endless-sky on Linux. Linux uses XDG_DATA_HOME if you set it. A Flatpak profile lives under ~/.var/app/io.github.endless_sky.endless_sky/data/endless-sky. If you start the game with --config, keep the folder you selected there.

references.title: Find the separate Android port
references.instruction: F-Droid carries a separately maintained Android port. Its versions and profile handling follow that port.
